summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `from enum import Enum` and the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum) class at the end of the module with all eleven members, values, and comments. (2) botocore/args.py: imported EndpointResolverBuiltins; the STS predicate _should_set_global_sts_endpoint now accepts a None endpoint config (no variant tags); added compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults after _ensure_boolean, reusing the bridge's FIPS and DualStack lookups and the existing STS and S3 predicates, returning all eleven keys. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with one test per behavioral criterion. Results: test_args.py, test_client.py, and test_regions.py pass (414 tests). Full tests/unit run: 3141 passed, 66 skipped, 11 failed. The same 11 failures occur on the original code (8 in test_awsrequest.py TestAWSHTTPConnection, 3 test_internal_component in test_session.py and test_session_legacy.py), so they are pre-existing and unrelated. Nothing committed. Note: the helper calls the bridge's private methods _resolve_endpoint_variant_config_var and _resolve_use_dualstack_endpoint, as the spec's reuse requirement implies; review this coupling if desired.
